newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends slightly down vs US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends slightly down vs US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed slightly down at 8.2911 on Monday from 8.2908 last Friday against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai due to a small amount of selling that emerged late in the session, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Friday was 8.2915.
Dealers said that although the yuan was forced below the 8.2910 level, pro-yuan sentiment was not hurt greatly.

The yuan opened unchanged at 8.2908 and moved around the 8.2910 level for most of the session, hitting an intraday high of 8.2906 before it went down to touch a low of 8.2914 and rebound slightly ahead of the close.
Trading was dull early but active later, dealers said.
"A small amount of selling emerged late in trading to depress the yuan, but the thin volume had little impact on the stable movement of the local currency," one dealer said.
A second dealer said that as no fresh market-driven factors emerged, investors remained cautious.
"Before the future trend is clearer, the yuan is expected to remain stable below the resistance level of 8.2900," he said.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to move around the 8.2910 level on Tuesday.
